name: hover
author: lumine-code
description: Show documentation tooltips and signature help at the cursor.

showOnMouseMove.title: Show On Mouse Move
showOnMouseMove.description: Show the hover tooltip when the mouse pointer rests on a symbol.

showOnCursorMove.title: Show On Cursor Move
showOnCursorMove.description: Show the hover tooltip when the cursor rests on a symbol. When disabled, the tooltip appears only via the `hover:toggle` command.

showDelay.title: Show Delay
showDelay.description: How long (in milliseconds) the mouse pointer or the cursor must rest before the hover tooltip is requested.

hideDelay.title: Hide Delay
hideDelay.description: How long (in milliseconds) the mouse pointer must be away from the hovered symbol before the tooltip is dismissed. Time spent over the tooltip itself does not count.

scrollChaining.title: Scroll Chaining
scrollChaining.description: Scroll the editor when the hover tooltip or signature help overlay reaches its scroll boundary or has no scrollable content.

showSignatureWhileTyping.title: Show Signature Help While Typing
showSignatureWhileTyping.description: Show the signature help overlay automatically when a trigger character is typed, and keep it updated while typing function arguments.

includeSignatureDocumentation.title: Include Signature Documentation
includeSignatureDocumentation.description: Include the documentation of the whole signature in the signature help overlay, below the documentation of the active parameter.
